transcript: My friend, sometimes nothing good happens to you because you are the good that happens to others. Let me explain. There are people in this world whose spirit is like a lantern, quiet, steady, glowing. They guide, support, and comfort everyone around them. Yet they themselves often walk through their own darkness alone. Maybe you know this feeling. You give your strength, your kindness, your patience. You hold others together, even when your own heart is tired. And still, life does not return the same softness to you. This is not misfortune. This is not punishment. It is because you are the blessing. You are the one who brings the good. When others are lost, they find you. When others are weak, they lean on you. When the world becomes heavy, your presence becomes the calm inside their storm. People like you hold entire worlds together and carry weights no one ever sees. But listen closely, my friend. Even the river that feeds all living things must receive rain. Even the healer needs healing. Even the giver must one day be held. A time will come when someone finally sees your light. Not for what you do, but for who you are. They will not drain you. They will match you. They will pour back into you the same way you have poured into so many others. Until that day arrives, do not question your worth. Do not think your path is unseen. When life feels silent, it is not because you are forgotten. It is because your gift is still working quietly in the hearts of others. You are the good that happens to others. And one day, my friend, goodness will return to you too.
